Dhanush said he once thought Mammootty was rude, referring to their collaboration on the film "Kammath And Kammath". He added that acting with the veteran could have "completely finished" him.

During a recent event in Kochi, a Malayalam actor humorously claimed his co‑star from the movie "O.M." cannot fall asleep without seeing him, prompting laughter among the audience.

The remarks highlight the candid camaraderie among South Indian cinema’s leading figures, drawing noticeable attention on social platforms.
